property.name: gravitino.entity.store
property.description: Which entity storage implementation to use.

property.name: gravitino.entity.store.relational
property.description: The maximum skew time of transactions in milliseconds.

property.name: gravitino.entity.store.deleteAfterTimeMs
property.description: The maximum time in milliseconds that deleted and old-version data is kept. Set to at least 10 minutes and no longer than 30 days.

property.name: gravitino.entity.store.versionRetentionCount
property.description: The Count of versions allowed to be retained, including the current version, used to delete old versions data. Set to at least 1 and no greater than 10.

property.name: gravitino.entity.store.relational
property.description: Detailed implementation of Relational storage. H2, MySQL and PostgreSQL is currently supported, and the implementation is JDBCBackend.

property.name: gravitino.entity.store.relational.jdbcUrl
property.description: The database url that the JDBCBackend needs to connect to.

property.name: gravitino.entity.store.relational.jdbcDriver
property.description: The jdbc driver name that the JDBCBackend needs to use. You should place the driver Jar package in the ${GRAVITINO_HOME}/libs/ directory.

property.name: gravitino.entity.store.relational.jdbcUser
property.description: The username that the JDBCBackend needs to use when connecting the database. It is required for MySQL.

property.name: gravitino.entity.store.relational.jdbcPassword
property.description: The password that the JDBCBackend needs to use when connecting the database. It is required for MySQL.

property.name: gravitino.entity.store.relational.storagePath
property.description: The storage path for embedded JDBC storage implementation.

property.name: gravitino.entity.store.relational.maxConnections
property.description: The maximum number of connections for the JDBC Backend connection pool.

property.name: gravitino.entity.store.relational.maxWaitMillis
property.description: The maximum wait time in milliseconds for a connection from the JDBC Backend connection pool.
